title: Book Two · Chapter 56: News of the Drawer
story:
On Saturday, Ronan goes with Dad to Mr Sun's counter. Dad needs a clean work cloth from his bag. Ronan carries a packet of lunch from Mum.

Mr Sun has a small paper beside the brown work cards.

“The lady came yesterday,” he says.

Dad stops beside the counter. “About the drawer?”

“Yes. She uses it each morning. It moves well at home.”

Ronan looks at the space on the counter. The brown box is not there. The lady has it at home, with its old brass handle. There is no box to open today.

“Every morning?” Ronan asks.

“That is her message,” Mr Sun says. “She keeps it in the same room.”

Dad reads the few words. Mr Sun gives Dad the message. Dad takes his own card and writes the day beside his notes.

“So it is all finished?” Ronan asks.

“This repair works for her now,” Dad says. “She knows she can come back.”

“Will she bring more boxes?”

“She did not say.”

Ronan puts the lunch packet on the clean part of the counter. He hopes a new customer will come in at once. Instead, a man comes for a chair leg. Mr Sun asks Dad about that job.

Dad checks the card. Then he answers. The chair leg needs more time. He shows the man the loose part. The man asks to collect it on Monday.

Dad looks at his other work. Then he agrees to Monday afternoon.

Ronan watches. Dad and the man finish the card. Nobody mentions the old box. The man leaves, and Dad takes the chair back to his bench.

“Are you pleased?” Ronan asks quietly.

Dad looks up. “About the box? Yes.”

“You do not look very pleased.”

Dad smiles. “I am counting four chair legs. My whole face has to help.”

Ronan counts them. One, two, three, four. He holds up four fingers.

“Now you can smile.”

Dad gives him a wide, silly smile. Mr Sun tells him to stop before a customer sees. Ronan laughs into his hand.

After lunch, Ronan goes home with Mum. They take the wider street because a delivery cart stands near the corner. Mum buys vegetables from a stall. Ronan carries the lighter bag.

At the green door, he tells her that the drawer works at home.

“Yes,” Mum says. “Dad told me.”

Ronan puts the vegetables in the kitchen. There is still room on the table for supper. He sets out three bowls and puts Dad's bowl in its usual place.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

drawer＝抽屉；message＝口信；repair＝修理。

## 理解问题

1. 顾客给Dad带来什么反馈？
2. 这条反馈没有解决什么问题？

## 读句子

**Mr Sun / gives / Dad the message.** Mr Sun／把口信／告诉Dad。
